name: Git Graph
description: Shows the commit graph of the focused workspace's Git repository.

settings.title: Graph style
settings.description: Shape of the lines joining commits.

settings.title: Branch colours
settings.description: Comma-separated CSS colours cycled through for branch lines.

settings.title: Ref label alignment
settings.description: Where branch and tag labels sit in the commit message column.

settings.title: Combine local and remote labels
settings.description: Show one label for main and origin/main when both point at the same commit.

settings.title: Details location
settings.description: Where the commit details view appears.
enumLabels: Automatic (right when wide, below when narrow)

settings.title: Mute merge commits
settings.description: Draw merge commits in a muted style.

settings.title: Date format
settings.description: How commit dates are shown.

settings.title: Date type
settings.description: Which date the Date column and ordering show.

settings.title: Commit order
settings.description: How commits are ordered in the graph.

settings.title: First parent only
settings.description: Follow only the first parent of merge commits when reading history.

settings.title: Initial commits
settings.description: Commits loaded when the graph opens.

settings.title: Commits per "Load more"
settings.description: Commits added each time Load more is pressed.

settings.title: Load more automatically
settings.description: Load the next commits when scrolling to the bottom of the graph.

settings.title: Scroll to HEAD on load
settings.description: Scroll to the checked-out commit when the graph opens.

settings.title: Show remote branches
settings.description: Include remote-tracking branches in the graph.

settings.title: Show tags
settings.description: Include tags in the graph.

settings.title: Show stashes
settings.description: Show stashes as rows attached to their base commit.

settings.title: Show uncommitted changes
settings.description: Show a row for the working tree when it has changes.

settings.title: Count untracked files
settings.description: Include untracked files in the uncommitted changes row.

settings.title: Watch working tree
settings.description: Refresh the graph when files in the working tree change (files ignored by Git are skipped). On Linux only the top-level directory is watched when recursive watching is unavailable.

settings.title: Use .mailmap
settings.description: Resolve author names and emails through the repository .mailmap.

settings.title: Show signature status
settings.description: Check commit signatures and mark them in the graph (slower on big repositories).

settings.title: Fetch avatars
settings.description: Download author avatars from Gravatar. This sends a hash of each author email to gravatar.com.

settings.title: Prune on fetch
settings.description: Pass --prune when fetching.

settings.title: Prune tags on fetch
settings.description: Pass --prune-tags when fetching.

settings.title: Custom branch globs
settings.description: One per line as "Name|glob", for example "Release|refs/heads/release/*". Shown in the branch filter.

settings.title: Custom emoji shortcodes
settings.description: JSON object mapping shortcode names to characters, for example {"shipit": "🚀"}.

settings.title: Create branch: check out
settings.description: Default for "Check out" in the Create Branch dialog.

settings.title: Add tag: type
settings.description: Default tag type in the Add Tag dialog.

settings.title: Merge: create a new commit
settings.description: Default for "Create a new commit even if fast-forward is possible".

settings.title: Merge: squash commits
settings.description: Default for "Squash commits" in the Merge dialog.

settings.title: Pull: create a new commit
settings.description: Default for "Create a new commit even if fast-forward is possible" in the Pull dialog.

settings.title: Rebase: ignore date
settings.description: Default for "Ignore date" in the Rebase dialog.

settings.title: Delete branch: force
settings.description: Default for "Force delete" in the Delete Branch dialog.

settings.title: Cherry-pick: record origin
settings.description: Default for "Record origin" (-x) in the Cherry Pick dialog.

settings.title: Stash: include untracked
settings.description: Default for "Include untracked files" in the Stash dialog.

settings.title: Stash: reinstate index
settings.description: Default for "Reinstate index" when applying or popping a stash.

settings.title: Reset to commit: mode
settings.description: Default mode when resetting the branch to a commit.

settings.title: Reset uncommitted: mode
settings.description: Default mode when resetting uncommitted changes.
